majorIds.Accretion Chain: Chain Lightning hits slower, rebounds, adds 6 chains, and pulls mobs closer for a 9999% explosion spell.

add.lore: The existence of all things is reflected in the otherworldly jewels of this grand staff, dense enough to have its own gravitational pull. Users have reported their limbs being stretched after usage.

Some mechs, particularly those built with long range in mind, are equipped with gyroscopic subcores like these to give more consistent aim and spatial control in active warfare. Fragile machinery compared to other systems, but a worthwhile trade compared to being staggered or raining fire on allies from being glanced by artillery.
The carving on this archaic piece of armor writes: Ketlednah Icsul

The ultimate folly of a heavyweight war machine. Too big to dodge and too easy to hit, with this core being the conclusion of this conflict. Still undeniably bulky, but just lightweight enough to allow rapid movement through short energy bursts. A luxury to most mechs of this scale.

Before the first breath was drawn from the open air, there was the slow, pulsing warmth of the deep. To walk the earth is to invite suffering into brittle bones, trading an eternal sanctuary for a world of choking dust and the aimless howling of the wind.

Reinforced leg plating for heavyweight machines. Built to last- and then some. Namely to hold such massive things up readily, but also to keep as pressing of a threat as long as possible- threatening destruction only under critical core damage, rather than being knocked down by a well placed hit.

majorIds.Brachiate: Grappling Hook has 25% increased range and increased velocity.

add.lore: Perched atop treetops far above, you watch the gentle sway of branches, leaves caressing the playful wind, and you finally feel at home.
The carving on this timeworn staff writes: Hisel Acetlrif

majorIds.Heat Shimmer: Foul Play will no longer slay a Mirror Clone and will still provide its effects, but Mirror Clone count is reduced to 1. Tricks application is increased by 50%.

add.lore: Double vision reshapes the moon's halo into the irises of an angel - radiant in their delicate, celestial beauty. Astigmatic lights sharpen into heavenly blades and you are the martyr to wield them.

Complex lenses such as the ones in this plating are specially designed to grant secondary visual guidance, offering rapid peripheral and otherwise situational awareness alongside the wider visual scope. A standard in certainty, always at least providing worst-case countermeasures in the densest fog of war.

after.lore: Originally designed to jumpstart disabled war machines on the battlefield. However, when worn on the neck, it instead delivers high-voltage shocks directly into the jugular whenever any major movement is made.
Don't blink. The brightest moments in life slip away in an instant, so etch every memory in your brain, and reach for them when you face your darkest hour.
Wait it out. Even the darkest storm clouds will eventually run out of rain if you give them enough time. Step back. Breathe. The sky clears on its own once the sun has had its say.
Seize the fleeting moment. Every tick of the clock is priceless, so pack every second with thrill, action, and laughter, and live the day to the fullest.

before.lore: War does not bring destruction. With war comes chaos, and with chaos comes destruction.

majorIds.Uncertainty Principle: Arrow and Grape Bombs gain +1 radius and phase through enemies. Bouncing Bomb has decreased velocity and gains +1 bounces, and Grape Bombs gain increased randomness and +2 projectiles.

after.lore: War does not bring destruction. With war comes chaos, and with chaos comes destruction.

before.lore: Countless lifetimes flash by in an instant. Will you break the cycle, or be consumed by the tides of eternity?

Launch into the heavens, then descend with the fury of a raging storm. Drag the sky down with you, and shatter it upon the earth in a devastating torrent of wind.

majorIds.Dead Weight: Totem's horizontal velocity is greatly increased at the cost of vertical movement.
Totem's horizontal velocity is greatly increased at the cost of vertical movement.

after.lore: When the Colossus they called Protector raised its sword, splintering the land like glass, the void opened its jaws to swallow the world. Earthenware dredged from the abyss were reshaped into pieces of armor. They pull at your heels like leaden anchors, and carry the strength of bedrock.

before.lore: The Fracturing brought Ahms into a shattered sky, sundering cliffs into an archipelago against the void. The tremors that linger carry an ancient power, bringing mountains to heel with ease and leaving devastation in its wake.

after.lore: The Fracturing brought Ahms into a shattered sky, sundering cliffs into an archipelago against the void. The tremors that linger carry an ancient power, bringing mountains to heel with ease and leaving devastation in its wake.
Moderato. Like the disciplined steps of a march, never skipping its appointed mark. A wand defined by a constancy that brings order to chaos.
Troubled water shatters the moon into fleeing silver; still water holds it whole. So a clear mind reflects the truth undistorted- and lets the enemy's wrath come like a sword to water.

majorIds.Pounce: Escape becomes a forward lunge.
Escape becomes a forward lunge.

after.lore: Is it bravery or stupidity that compels you to stare into the jaws of death once more?

majorIds.Sublimation: Totemic Shatter heals 75% of Regeneration's usual amount at the cost of 2 blocks of radius.
Totemic Shatter heals 75% of Regeneration's usual amount at the cost of 2 blocks of radius.

after.lore: A paper cut triggers immediate cauterization. A cracked rib is instantly encased in a cage of white-hot plasma. You did not ask to wake up smoking every morning, but according to diagnostic logs, your survival rate has never been higher.

majorIds.Windsurf: Righting Reflex has 75% reduced fall speed, lasts twice as long, and is affected stronger by movement speed.
Righting Reflex has 75% reduced fall speed, lasts twice as long, and is affected stronger by movement speed.

after.lore: Weightless as a fallen feather, yet lethal as a hawk’s descent. Its beveled edge reshapes the slipstream to cradle your form, tugging you through the air as you deliver strike after strike, movements blurring into a flurry of beating wings.

after.lore: A01 welded its chamber shut on the first shot. A05 kept launching the trigger instead of the shell. A11 launched both. When the A16 finally sent the ammo where you aimed it, the lead Corkian engineer wept, stamped "APPROVED" on the paperwork, and handed the blueprint to the Factory.
Watch the clock freeze. The silence before the storm drags like an eternity, so reinforce your gear, steady your restless mind, and brace yourself for the long haul.
Look at the road behind you. The familiar warmth of your journey proves you haven't forgotten your roots, and the familiar faces still standing by your side proves that they are here to stay.
Keep your eyes forward. The scent of the fresh earth you've kicked up proves you are moving, and the long road ahead proves you have somewhere to be.

majorIds.Sorcery: 25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.
25% chance for spells and attacks to cast a second time at no additional cost.

after.lore: Distant wails of a bygone time still chime amidst impossibly tall walls of stone – now nothing more than memories, mere mimics of lonely cries.

majorIds.Hellfire: Bash is replaced by a single hit, gaining +3 radius and dealing +85%, +10%, and +60%. Boiling Blood's cooldown is set to 2s, gains +40%, +50%, and burns twice as fast for 1s, but can't slow.

before.lore: To forge a weapon such as this from the cursed lava of the portal basin requires dozens, for each smith would lose themselves to the force of corruption before it is finished. The nightmarishly hooked blade serves no purpose but destruction, as intended.

Presto. Like a viper's strike, retreating before the prey even feels the fang. A blade defined by a speed that leaves no memory of its passing.
Let time slip away. The nature of the mind is to wander, so stare blankly at the sky, let go of your worries, and enjoy a carefree day.
Seek the opportune moment. Every wall has a crack that opens when the pressure shifts. Strike decisively when the light seeps through. The treasure will be yours.

majorIds.Cosmic Capture: Meteor falls twice as fast, has +3 blast radius, and pulls enemies upon impact.

after.lore: The world suffocates under pressure, the seasons decay under age. The rivers dry up and the oceans flood the land while you helplessly watch your friends drop like flies.

before.lore: Mysterious runes, held by inexplicable ancient guardians, were once moulded together for study purposes. The experiment went awry, as the runic words Nii, Az, and Ek were combined in a reaction that resulted in the collapse of a civilization.

Largo. Like the deep ocean tides governed by the moon, indifferent to the hurry of the world. A spear defined by a crushing momentum that nothing can halt.

Masks were carved in his honor, tributes to a chief whose heart of stone was a symbol of boundless, fearless strength. How cruel, then, that when the madness took him, that heart kept its vow to the very end. It warded off death and warded off remorse, leaving behind a monster as cold and unyielding as the cairn in his chest.
Adagio. Like the heavy hammer of a blacksmith, striking slow to shape tempered steel. A crossbow defined by the deliberate power of its draw.

majorIds.Altruism: Allies within 16 blocks gain 100% of the health you gain from Health Regen and Life Steal.

before.lore: Wielded by the chief of the Tromsian jungle's zombie tribes, the augmentable crystals within it focus natural elemental energies to intense levels.

after.lore: The once-chief of the Iboju tribe held a sacred duty: a revitalizing defense of the jungle, reducing smoldering bones of invaders to rich ash that fed the soil. Yet, as the undead plight wore on, duty curdled into obsession. He became the very monster he sought to destroy, seeing horrors in every living soul and purging them for a land he lost his mind to save.
